main_theorem: Every finite minimal marked C-cover of a contiguous parabolic occurs as that parabolic in some finite minimal C-cover of the whole finite marked group.
polytope_corollary: For finite polytopes of arbitrary rank, any non-C four-consecutive-mark subgroup of monodromy implies infinitely many finite minimal regular polytopal covers.
finite_diagnostic: One non-polytopal order64 independent marking, its order128 C-cover and all parabolic intersections.
excluded: Rank-five exploratory graph-of-tori work and geometric filling literature notes are not included.
